'''Alan Romanczuk''' is an editorial assistant to [[Team Jordan]]. He specializes in keeping the timeline straight (leading to the nickname of [[Wikipedia:Time Lord|Time Lord]]), as well as being an expert resource in military history. He also served as tech support of sorts, fixing computers and de-infecting [[Robert Jordan]]'s computer on at least one occasion. He contributed heavily to the [[Wheel of Time Companion]] following the completion of the novels.

He is married to Amy Nadel Romanczuk, who is publishing a book of Wheel of Time-related coloring pages.
